name: EUR/GBP ATR Breakout Fade Strategy
description: Mean-reversion strategy that trades EUR/GBP when EUR/USD or GBP/USD daily ranges exceed their 14-day ATR. Shorts EUR/GBP on EUR/USD volatility spikes, longs EUR/GBP on GBP/USD volatility spikes. Holds for 3 days for mean reversion.
source:
# EUR/GBP ATR Breakout Fade Strategy
# Mean-reversion: fade extreme moves in component pairs

# Main trading pair data (EUR/GBP)
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
eurgbp_close = src.c
eurgbp_high = src.h
eurgbp_low = src.l

# Reference pair data: EUR/USD
eurusd = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.EURUSD)()
eurusd_high = eurusd.h
eurusd_low = eurusd.l
eurusd_close = eurusd.c

# Reference pair data: GBP/USD
gbpusd = common_fx_pairs(ticker=ReferenceFXPair.GBPUSD)()
gbpusd_high = gbpusd.h
gbpusd_low = gbpusd.l
gbpusd_close = gbpusd.c

# Calculate True Range for reference pairs
# TR = max(H-L, |H-prev_close|, |L-prev_close|)
# For simplicity, we use daily range (H-L) as an approximation since we don't have crossover prev close

# EUR/USD: True Range approximation using max of range and gap from prior close
eurusd_prev_close = eurusd_close >> 1
eurusd_tr1 = eurusd_high - eurusd_low
eurusd_tr2 = abs(eurusd_high - eurusd_prev_close)
eurusd_tr3 = abs(eurusd_low - eurusd_prev_close)
eurusd_tr = eurusd_tr1 if eurusd_tr1 >= eurusd_tr2 and eurusd_tr1 >= eurusd_tr3 else (eurusd_tr2 if eurusd_tr2 >= eurusd_tr3 else eurusd_tr3)
eurusd_atr = ma(period=14, type=MAType.sma)(eurusd_tr)

# GBP/USD: True Range
gbpusd_prev_close = gbpusd_close >> 1
gbpusd_tr1 = gbpusd_high - gbpusd_low
gbpusd_tr2 = abs(gbpusd_high - gbpusd_prev_close)
gbpusd_tr3 = abs(gbpusd_low - gbpusd_prev_close)
gbpusd_tr = gbpusd_tr1 if gbpusd_tr1 >= gbpusd_tr2 and gbpusd_tr1 >= gbpusd_tr3 else (gbpusd_tr2 if gbpusd_tr2 >= gbpusd_tr3 else gbpusd_tr3)
gbpusd_atr = ma(period=14, type=MAType.sma)(gbpusd_tr)

# EUR/GBP: Use built-in ATR since it's the main market_data_source
eurgbp_atr = atr(period=14)()

# Calculate daily ranges
eurusd_range = eurusd_high - eurusd_low
gbpusd_range = gbpusd_high - gbpusd_low

# Entry signals
# SHORT EUR/GBP when EUR/USD range >= EUR/USD ATR (fade EUR strength)
short_entry = eurusd_range >= eurusd_atr

# LONG EUR/GBP when GBP/USD range >= GBP/USD ATR (fade GBP strength)
long_entry = gbpusd_range >= gbpusd_atr

# Use long_and_short_zone with 3-bar hold for fixed time exit
# hold_long=3 and hold_short=3 means hold for 3 days
long_and_short_zone(hold_long=3, hold_short=3, strict_hold=True)(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Position sizing inversely proportional to EUR/GBP ATR
# Target a fixed risk amount - use inverse ATR weighting
# Normalize: base size divided by ATR (higher ATR = smaller position)
base_risk_pct = 2.0  # 2% base risk
atr_normalized = eurgbp_atr / eurgbp_close  # ATR as percentage of price
target_size = base_risk_pct / (atr_normalized * 100)  # Inverse ATR sizing

# Cap position size at reasonable levels (max 10%)
position_pct = target_size if target_size < 10 else 10.0

# Apply position sizing only when entry signals fire
# The long_and_short_zone handles position holding; we size on entry
final_size = position_pct if (long_entry or short_entry) else 0.0
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=final_size)

# Exit detection for event markers (3 bars after entry)
bars_since_long = barssince()(long_entry)
bars_since_short = barssince()(short_entry)
long_exit = bars_since_long == 3
short_exit = bars_since_short == 3
any_exit = long_exit or short_exit

# Event markers
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Short Entry",
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="EUR/USD Range", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="EUR/USD ATR", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(eurusd_range, eurusd_atr, short_entry)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Long Entry",
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="GBP/USD Range", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="GBP/USD ATR", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(gbpusd_range, gbpusd_atr, long_entry)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Exit",
        icon=Icon.XCircleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="EUR/GBP Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(title="Exit Signal", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(eurgbp_close, any_exit)

# Dashboard: ATR and Range visualization
timeseries_lines(
    title="EUR/USD: Range vs ATR",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Daily Range", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="14-Day ATR", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(eurusd_range, eurusd_atr)

timeseries_lines(
    title="GBP/USD: Range vs ATR",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Daily Range", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="14-Day ATR", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(gbpusd_range, gbpusd_atr)

timeseries_lines(
    title="EUR/GBP ATR (Position Sizing Basis)",
    category="Risk",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="14-Day ATR", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(eurgbp_atr)

timeseries_lines(
    title="Position Size %",
    category="Risk",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Size %", color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(final_size)
